title: Felix and the Echo
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Delacroix, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
